title: Human Cancer-Targeted Immunity via Transgenic Hematopoietic Stem Cell Progeny
description: Analysis of a patient biopsy from the clinical trial (NCT03240861), a first-in-human study of transgenic NY-ESO-1 TCR- T cells and NY-ESO-1 TCR+ sr39tk autologous hematopoietic stem cells tandem therapy for solid tumors after myeloablative conditioning chemotherapy with busulfan and fludarabine. Single-cell RNAseq and single-cell ATACseq analysis from peripheral blood mononuclear cells obtained from subject NYSCT-03.
